flow-definition.description: Downloads one Terraform env template for the selected service. Each service has a single template shared by both stacks; a change takes effect the next time that service renders and deploys.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Infrastructure repository revision used for the final fallback. Leave empty to resolve it from build-spec.json.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: SERVICE
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Service whose Terraform env template should be downloaded.
